plan.experiment: E011 - Combine ball tracking at the catch point: feasibility (descriptive)
plan.written: 2026-10-15T03:59:56Z (UTC), after the data exploration of the BALL rows and before any catch mechanic was computed as a player value, before any reliability, and before any association with any Combine measure or game outcome
already_seen_before_this_plan: BALL rows: 2025 class only, 551 attempts, 54 players (37 WR, 17 TE), 18 drill names; ball rows share the receiver's timestamps; x/y only (no height).

Ball device speed: pre-throw < ~10 yd/s, flight 13-26 yd/s decaying smoothly, then an abrupt one-frame drop at contact. Post-catch carried ball median 0.67 yd from the receiver's tracked point, with no detectable ball-vs-player clock lag (offset along the receiver's velocity does not scale with his speed).
Post-contact behaviour is a continuum: most balls stay within ~1.3 yd of the receiver; a tail separates (ball passes him, or is dropped/deflected).

Rookie exposure (2025 REG): 17 WR and 7 TE of the 54 have >= 10 targets; 35 own-target dropped_pass events in total. dropped_pass is a play-level event attached to every tracked player on the play, so a player's drop requires target == True.
No association of any catch mechanic with anything has been computed.

detection.release: first frame of the first run of >= 3 frames with ball s >= 12 yd/s
detection.contact: first frame after release with ball s < 0.75 x the previous frame's; t_contact = 0.05 s before that frame (midpoint); none if tracking ends in flight
detection.reached: min ball-receiver distance over the last in-flight frame and the 3 frames after it <= 2.0 yd
detection.outcome: secured (inferred catch) if reached and, 0.2-0.7 s after the first post-contact frame, median ball-receiver distance <= 2.0 yd and its growth over that window <= 1.5 yd; separated (inferred incompletion: drop, deflection or ball past him) if reached and not secured; not_reached; unobserved (contact not observed, or < 0.7 s of tracking after it). Inferred, unvalidated: the data have no catch labels.

mechanics.retention: receiver SG speed 0.5 s after contact / 0.5 s before; secured catches with speed before >= 3 yd/s and tracking through +0.5 s
mechanics.decel_in: (speed 0.5 s before contact - speed at contact) / 0.5 s, yd/s^2 (> 0 = slowing into the catch); reached attempts
mechanics.catch_offset: perpendicular distance (yd) of the receiver's tracked point at contact from the ball's 2D flight line (last 3 in-flight positions); reached attempts. 2D only: ball height unknown
mechanics.adjust_dist: distance (yd) between the receiver's position at contact and his constant-velocity extrapolation from the release frame; adjustment drills (OVER_SHOULDER_ADJUST, CIRCUS_ROUTE_LEFT, RED_ZONE_FADE_RIGHT, END_ZONE_FADE_RIGHT); reached
mechanics.adjust_time: time (s) from release until the angle between the receiver's velocity and the bearing to the eventual catch point is <= 20 deg and stays so (frames > 2 yd from the catch point, up to 0.3 s before contact); adjustment drills; reached

plan.player_values: per mechanic: player x drill mean, z-scored within drill x Combine session (segments.combine_sessions), mean over the player's drills
plan.reliability: reliability.cross_drill_icc on player x drill means, zscore=True, center_by=[drill_name, session]; Spearman-Brown to each player's number of drills, averaged (the as-used reliability). Gate: >= 0.5

exploratory_tests_if_gate_passes.label: prelisted exploratory (no primary tests in E011); at most 3 tests in total, chosen by the rule below
exploratory_tests_if_gate_passes.population: the 54 ball-tracked 2025 WR/TE with >= 10 REG rookie targets (>= 5 catches for YACOE)

targets.croe: catch rate over expected per target: caught (pass_result C) minus a cross-fitted (GroupKFold by game) HistGradientBoosting P(catch) from pass_length (air yards), separation_at_pass_forward, team_coverage_man_zone, receiver_alignment, down, yards_to_go, yards_to_end_zone, season; trained on all study WR/TE REG targets 2023-25; shrinkage.eb_rate(cluster=game_id) with the prior fitted on all study WR/TE with >= 10 2025 REG targets
targets.yacoe: yards_after_catch - expected_yards_after_catch (NGS) per catch; shrinkage.eb_mean(cluster=game_id), prior on all study WR/TE with >= 5 2025 REG catches
targets.drop_rate: own drops per target (dropped_pass event on a play where the player is the target) over the base rate; shrinkage.eb_rate(cluster=game_id), prior on all study WR/TE with >= 10 2025 REG targets

exploratory_tests_if_gate_passes.selection_rule: test each mechanic with reliability >= 0.5 against its paired target, in descending order of reliability, up to 3 tests; if fewer than 3 mechanics pass and catch_offset passes, also catch_offset -> drop_rate (expected sign -1)
exploratory_tests_if_gate_passes.harness: linkage.evaluate with REDUCED controls: combine_controls=['forty'], draft_controls=DRAFT_CONTROLS (position + 40 time + draft capital; year dummies are constant). The full B2 (~15 design columns) leaves resid_df < 10 at n ~ 24, where the harness's partial correlation is degenerate. n_repeats=50, n_perm=2000, n_perm_fl=10000, seed 0, n_jobs=3. LOCO is undefined (one class).
exploratory_tests_if_gate_passes.power_stated_up_front: n ~ 24 with 5 design columns: resid_df ~ 18, one-sided MDE (80% power, alpha 0.05) of the observed partial r ~ 0.54; with feature reliability ~0.5 and target reliability ~0.3 the true-score MDE exceeds 1. Any null here bounds nothing useful; any hit is a lead for future classes, not evidence.
exploratory_tests_if_gate_passes.also_report: target split-half reliability (odd/even games) on all study WR/TE with enough targets, Spearman-Brown at the rookies' median count; EB mean weight for the rookies; corr(target, log n)

plan.descriptive: Spearman r (Fisher 95% CI) of each player mechanic with the 40 time, 10-yd split, tracked flying 20 (speed.combine_speed_table c40_v_20_40), tracked 40 peak speed (c40_smax), vertical, broad jump, 3-cone, shuttle, weight, height, hand size, arm length; Combine measures centered within position; descriptive only, no multiplicity claims

clock_lag_check.note: slope_lon_on_speed_s[*] is the original check (a ball clock lagging by tau gives slope -tau); ball handling also moves the ball along his body as his speed changes, so it does not identify a lag (see within_attempt_slope_s and the offset-free velocity_matching)

within_attempt_slope_s.label: post hoc (after review): lon and speed demeaned within attempt

velocity_matching.label: post hoc (after review): offset-free clock check

contact_time_check.label: post hoc (after review); replaces the first version, which searched only [t_(k-1), t_(k-1) + 0.2 s] and so was bounded to [-0.05, +0.15] s around t_contact by construction (withdrawn)
contact_time_check.what: t of the unanchored ball-receiver closest approach minus t_contact (ball-speed drop); the tracked point is the shoulder pads, not the hands, so +-1 frame is expected

ball_short_of_receiver_at_last_flight_fr.what: ball minus receiver along the ball's flight line at frame k - 1 < 0 (contact not detected late)

outcome_posthoc.label: post hoc (after review): the preregistered `outcome` is unchanged; these classes are all not_reached and carry no mechanic

reached_meeting_the_pass_rule.note: reached attempts whose 2D path also passed his tracked point >= 0.15 s before first impact (deep balls over the shoulder): the rule identifies misses only among not_reached

remaining_not_reached.note: first impact > 2 yd from his tracked point without passing close in flight (short or wide throws); those where the ball ends beside him may be extended-arm catches or pick-ups

decomposition.label: post hoc (after review): what adjust_dist measures
decomposition.what: along = component of (catch point - release-time extrapolation) along his release heading; share_along = median of along^2 / adjust_dist^2; corr_along_speed_change = Pearson r of along with (his speed at contact - his speed at release)

drills_needed_range_from_icc_ci.note: distinct drills (cross-drill ICC), not repeated catches; None = unbounded (CI reaches <= 0)

detection.outcome_posthoc / attempts.outcome_posthoc: not_reached split into passed_him (ball passed within 1.5 yd in flight, >= 0.15 s before its first impact), ball_unrelated (ball never within 5 yd: rows of another throw) and not_reached; preregistered `outcome` unchanged; mechanics unchanged (all three are not_reached)
